AI agents

Paper Agent

A research-paper assistant that connects retrieval, reading, summaries, and citations in one structured workflow.

Workflow
  1. Retrieve
  2. Read & summarize
  3. Verify & cite
  • Python
  • LangGraph
  • LangChain
  • Chroma
View repository paper_agent
Project details
  • LangGraph coordinates routing and paper-related tasks.
  • Short-term context supports follow-up requests; Chroma stores longer-term paper memory.
  • The repository includes citation, PDF-download, and paper-search components.
LLM research

ETFALL

An experimental toolkit for studying emotional tone and toxicity across languages, and exploring bias mitigation in LLMs.

Workflow
  1. Generate
  2. Evaluate
  3. Mitigate
  • Python
  • vLLM
  • Detoxify
  • LoRA
View repository etfall
Project details
  • Evaluation scripts cover Qwen and Llama models with multilingual datasets.
  • Detoxify scores toxicity; the repository includes language-comparison plots.
  • Mitigation experiments include prompts, LoRA training, and vector steering. Toxicity is one measurement, rather than a complete measure of emotional fairness.
